reviews.text: Axie Infinity is a P2E game with AXS and SLP tokens. Launched in 2018, it peaked in 2021. In 2025, the Ronin chain has upgrades. The project is community-driven. It’s a gaming pioneer.

Axie Infinity is a blockchain-based game where players collect and battle NFT Axies. In its beginnings (2021), players in developing countries earned real income through its play-to-earn model. Actually, Axie Infinity remains well-known but struggling. Key issues emerged: its in-game currency SLP became severely inflationary, and NFT plots (LAND) cost thousands of dollars, blocking new players' adoption. On the other side, its Ronin sidechain was hacked for $620M in 2022, reducing trust. Axie was revolutionary in gaming crypto, but its token economics and security holes have reduced interest.
The project is one of the P2E platforms. It's Blockchain gaming that involves DeFI. Users can immerse themselves in the game and get rewarded significantly

Axie Infinity is a pioneer blockchain based play to earn gaming protocol initially launched on Ethereum in 2018 by Sky Mavis. Later, Axie Infinity migrated to their own EVM compatible layer 1 Ronin, which is an Ethereum sidechain in order to achieve instant and near zero fee transactions suitable for handling millions of players.  
Axie infinity uses dual token model comprising Axie Infinity Shards  $AXS ( a governance and staking token) and Smooth Love Potion $SPL (a utility and reward token). Developed by Experienced team members backed by top VCs like a16z, Accel, Paradigm, and Mark Cuban. In 2022, a serious security incident happened on the Ronin network where their bridge was exploited which resulted in losing over $600 Million  in Ethereum and USDC. After the incident, Sky Mavis was able to raise additional capital to compensate affected users and provide more security for the protocol. Ronin is planning to migrate and become an Ethereum layer 2 for better security and cheaper cost.

Axie was a pioneer in play to earn gaming, which I find visionary for a while, players in some countries were genuinely earning income by playing it. The project had a real economy with NFTs and tokens, which is cool. On the flip side, the market got saturated with similar games and some unforeseen issues like the Ronin bridge hack hurt trust. So these days I see Axie as an interesting piece of history, but I’d be cautious about it being a great investment.

Axie Infinity is a blockchain based play-to-earn (P2E) game built on Ethereum’s Ronin sidechain. The game allows players to collect, breed, and battle fantasy creatures called Axies, with a strong emphasis on player ownership and the ability to earn rewards through gameplay. Axie Infinity has gained massive popularity, especially in countries like the Philippines, where it became a source of income for many players. By integrating blockchain and non-fungible tokens (NFTs), Axie Infinity has created a new model for gaming that allows players to truly own in game assets, such as Axies, land, and other collectibles. However, its sustainability has been questioned due to fluctuating token prices and economic challenges within the game’s ecosystem.
